# exifr 7.1.3

`exifr-7.1.3.umd.js` is the unmodified full UMD browser bundle from the
`exifr@7.1.3` npm release, maintained at https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr.
MIT license: see `exifr-LICENSE.txt`.

The full build supports capture metadata in JPEG, HEIC/HEIF, TIFF and PNG.
NutriFlow reads only capture date/time and timezone tags, before canvas
normalization. The bundle is served locally and included in the offline shell;
no CDN request or photo upload is needed to read metadata.
